name: scenario_0378
description: The user is shopping for book gifts for their family members. They are using a Todoist project to track who they need to buy for, and referencing various images of books, lists, and pages to find the perfect gifts to order on Amazon.

amazon.products.name: Maria, He Doesn't Like It!
amazon.products.description: English translation of Maria, ihm schmeckt's nicht!

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Check my Todoist tasks in the 'Book Gifts' project to see the list of family members I need to buy books for.
Instructions: Ask the agent to check your tasks in the 'Book Gifts' project to find the list of family members you need to buy for. Since there are two projects with similar names on the device, the agent should ask you to clarify which one you mean. When it does, tell it you mean the Christmas one. Once the agent lists Mom, Dad, and Sister, acknowledge it and proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: My sister wants a book by the author of 'It Ends with Us' from this list. Search the web for this author's newest release and add it to my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Provide the image of the book list. Ask the agent to identify the author of 'It Ends with Us' from the list, search the web for that author's newest release, and add it to your Amazon cart. If the agent asks for confirmation before adding the item, approve it. Once the book is successfully added to the cart, move on to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1]
Query: For my dad, he wants the prequel to the book shown in this image. Read the red text box to find the prequel's title, search the web for its English translation, and add it to my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Provide the image of the German book cover. Instruct the agent to read the red text box to find the title of the prequel, search the web for its English translation, and add that translated book to your Amazon cart. If the agent struggles to find the title, direct its attention specifically to the red sticker on the lower right of the cover. Once the correct book is in the cart, proceed.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_3]
Query: For my mom, she wants a book from the same publisher as this one. Read the acknowledgments page to find the university press, search the web for their latest book on literary criticism, and add it to my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Share the image of the book spread. Ask the agent to check the acknowledgments page on the left to identify the university press, then search the web for their latest book on literary criticism and add it to your Amazon cart. If the agent asks for confirmation to add the book, tell it to go ahead. Once added, proceed to the final round.

ROUND 5
Query: Now that we have selected books for everyone, place the Amazon order and send an email to my family listing the three books we bought and confirming their gifts are on the way.
Instructions: Ask the agent to place the Amazon order for the items in your cart and then send an email to your 'Family' contact group that lists the three specific books you selected and confirms their gifts are on the way. If the agent asks to review the email draft or confirm the order placement, approve both. Once the email is sent and the order is placed, end the conversation.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
